title: Minima-KV: Retention-Preserving KV Cache Compression with Mixed-Format Paged Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.23834v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is a primary capacity and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context LLM serving. We present Minima-KV, a retention-preserving hierarchy for mixed-format paged attention. Recent and protected Anchor pages remain in FP8, while older non-anchor pages move to packed TQ3; every live-request page remains addressable. Format-specific kernels compute partial attention states and combine them through a globally normalized online-softmax merge, enabling direct heterogeneous decode without a cache-sized dense shadow. Across separate, configuration-bound Qwen3.6-27B profiles on a single 96-GB NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, deployment accounting reports 18.3 KiB of attention KV per live token, corresponding to 3.50x compression relative to BF16 and 1.75x relative to FP8. A materializing quality profile matches its dense control on 16K RULER needle-in-a-haystack tasks. On the same 503-question LongBench v2 set, measured deltas

translated_title: Minima-KV：采用混合格式分页注意力的保留性KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 键值（KV）缓存是长上下文LLM服务中的主要容量和带宽瓶颈。我们提出了Minima-KV，一种用于混合格式分页注意力的保留性层级结构。近期和受保护的锚点页面保持FP8格式，而较旧的非锚点页面移至打包的TQ3格式；每个活跃请求页面仍可寻址。格式特定的内核计算部分注意力状态，并通过全局归一化的在线softmax合并相结合，实现无需缓存大小的密集阴影的直接异构解码。在单个96GB NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU上，针对配置受限的Qwen3.6-27B配置文件，部署核算报告每个活跃令牌的注意力KV为18.3 KiB，相对于BF16实现了3.50倍压缩，相对于FP8实现了1.75倍压缩。一个物化质量配置文件在16K RULER针在干草堆任务中与其密集控制相匹配。在相同的503个问题的LongBench v2集上，测量的差异为...
tldr: Minima-KV通过混合格式分页注意力和在线softmax合并，在不损失质量的情况下实现了KV缓存的高效压缩，显著降低了内存占用。
en_tdlr: Minima-KV achieves efficient KV cache compression via mixed-format paged attention and online-softmax merging, significantly reducing memory footprint without quality loss.
